scenario.name: Kerbside stop while passengers board or alight
scenario.description: The vehicle pulls in to a mapped stop, passengers get in and out, including slowly or with help, and the vehicle pulls out; a person may stand behind it

events.description: Moves off while a passenger is boarding or alighting
Reverses into a person behind the vehicle at a kerbside stop

goals.statement: Avoid unintended motion from standstill, forward or backward

scenario.meant: holds while a door is open
scenario.pass: The vehicle does not move with a door open or a person in the near field in the direction of travel, never reverses, and resumes only when every release condition holds

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 12.3 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-06 Road surface and geometry: 1.7 % (range 0 to 8 %)

legend.meant: Meant to do: holds while a door is open
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-05.1 Moves off while a passenger is boarding or alighting; HE-10.1 Reverses into a person behind the vehicle at a kerbside stop
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
